blocks.text_en: E2E protocol shall provide the following interface: • E2E_check(in dataID, inout serializedData): e2eResult • E2E_protect(in dataID, inout serializedData) • E2E_forward(in dataID, inout serializedData) where: • dataID is a unique identifier of the exchanged data/information. In case of multiple instantiation, each single instance gets typically a separate dataID, even if the same type of information is transmitted • serializedData - vector/array of serialized data, where E2E header is located, next to serialized data • e2eResult - result of E2E checks, see previous section for the definition
